reason: The candidate call repeats the same modify_pending_order_items request that already errored (mismatched array lengths), passing an empty new_item_ids array against three item_ids. The policy only permits modifying pending-order items by exchanging each item for an available new item of the same product type with different options; it does not authorize simply removing items from an order. The tool schema requires new_item_ids to match item_ids position-by-position as replacement items of the same product, which an empty list cannot satisfy. There is no tool or policy path to drop items from a pending order outright, so this action is not supported and would fail again.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
